letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle breezes of Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Even as the calendar flips to spring, my heart stays forever stuck on the day we said “I do”—23 February 2025. Your laughter lights up my world, your love wraps around me like the coziest shawl, and your smile makes every moment feel like a sweet adventure. Thank you for being my forever cutie and the love that makes every day magical.
poem:
In desert sands or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm to my refrain.  
With you, my heart forever sings,  
Together we soar on endless wings.
